description: 2D Solar Panels (LGATE-350) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This dataset is an AI extracted feature polygon indicating the location of solar panels. This dataset was provisioned through CaptureWA with the approval of WALIS (Western Australian Land Information System). It covers the LGAs of; City of Joondalup, City of Kalamunda, Shire of Mundaring, Shire of Capel, Shire of Donnybrook-Balingup, Shire of Bridgetown-Greenbushes. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are AI, Artificial Intelligence, CaptureWA, Local Government, Solar Panels. It offers 10 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
